0.4.description: The README's recipe: stock 0.24 mm H2C process and PETG Translucent on the right 0.4 mm Standard hotend, with the October 6 Mark1 cavity retry's changes (task 1315124888, whose cavity completed; print-log.md).
0.4.process_name: Funnel mold - six walls - 15% gyroid - PETG088
0.4.filament_name: Funnel mold PETG Translucent - 0.4 Standard - flow 0.88

z_trim.reason: Derek's +0.04 mm for the October 6 Mark1 cavity retry (native-slice-reviews/2026-10-06-mark1-retry-z004-v2); the October 7 core used the same (zone-c/funnel-mold/print-log.md).

wall_loops.reason: Six walls: continuous forming and dry-back perimeters (README).

bottom_shell_layers.reason: Six bottom layers; dry-side breathers are drilled after printing (README).

sparse_infill_density.reason: 15% gyroid; the September 16 15% cavity worked well (zone-c/funnel-mold/print-log.md).

sparse_infill_pattern.reason: Three-dimensional infill without crossings within a layer (README).

skeleton_infill_density.reason: As the October 6 Mark1 cavity retry (native-slice-reviews/2026-10-06-mark1-retry-z004-v2).

skin_infill_density.reason: As the October 6 Mark1 cavity retry (native-slice-reviews/2026-10-06-mark1-retry-z004-v2).

brim_object_gap.reason: 0.10 mm brim gap, as the October 6 Mark1 cavity retry (native-slice-reviews/2026-10-06-mark1-retry-z004-v2).

enable_support.reason: Removable support under the eight bolt pockets' flat washer-bearing ceilings (README).

support_type.reason: Snug normal supports for the bolt pockets (README): tall tree supports detached or were knocked over on September 14, and Snug columns stood on September 16 and on October 6 (zone-c/funnel-mold/print-log.md).

support_style.reason: Snug normal supports for the bolt pockets (README).

support_object_xy_distance.reason: 0.48 mm XY gap, as the October 6 Mark1 cavity retry (native-slice-reviews/2026-10-06-mark1-retry-z004-v2).

support_object_first_layer_gap.reason: As the October 6 Mark1 cavity retry (native-slice-reviews/2026-10-06-mark1-retry-z004-v2).

filament_flow_ratio.reason: 0.88 flow on the Standard nozzle; the September 18 cavity at 0.88 reduced the overflow defect (zone-c/funnel-mold/print-log.md).

filament_max_volumetric_speed.reason: 5.61702 mm3/s on the Standard nozzle with the 0.88 flow (zone-c/funnel-mold/print-log.md, September 18).

0.8.description: The September 14 left 0.8 mm High Flow trial recipe (print-log.md, 0.40 mm support trial).

skirt_loops.reason: Stock machine sequence primes the nozzle.
